result_summary.title: Critical: Stale Data in Invoice Service for EU-Central Production
result_summary.description: Our Invoice Service in EU-Central production is displaying stale data for a vast majority of users (nearly 6000). The information on invoices is not reflecting recent changes or payments. We are certain this is a policy misconfiguration issue on your end, preventing the data sync from occurring correctly. Please adjust the data retention or sync policies immediately to restore accurate invoicing.
